code='''def transform(grid):
    """Copy the marked pattern onto every matching background position."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    counts = {c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid) for c in colors}
    # The marked pattern is the color occurring least often; other colors form the field.
    marker = min(counts, key=counts.get)
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    minr = min(r for r, c in points)
    minc = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-minr, c-minc) for r, c in points]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    maxr = h - 1 - max(r for r, c in shape)
    maxc = w - 1 - max(c for r, c in shape)
    for r0 in range(-min(r for r,c in points), h):
        for c0 in range(-min(c for r,c in points), w):
            cells = [(r0+r, c0+c) for r,c in shape]
            if all(0 <= r < h and 0 <= c < w and grid[r][c] == background for r,c in cells):
                for r,c in cells:
                    out[r][c] = marker
    return out
'''
